title: A variable remembers a value.
heading: A variable remembers a value.
description: Give a value a name so you can use it again.
placeholder: Try it on the next slide

explanation.title: Store the name
explanation.text: The = stores the text Ola in a variable called username.

explanation.title: Use the stored value
explanation.text: Without quotes, username means the stored value, so the fox says Ola. "username" would just be text.

explanation.title: Build a greeting
explanation.text: You’ve used + to join strings. Here it joins "Hello " to the stored name, making Hello Ola. Keep the space after Hello!
